beats.text: The famous bitcoin pizza was an open offer, not a one off.
beats.note: Laszlo Hanyecz posted on a forum that he would pay 10,000 bitcoin for a couple of pizzas.

beats.name: Laszlo Hanyecz
beats.role: Programmer who bought two Papa John's pizzas on 22 May 2010, the first known commercial bitcoin transaction.

beats.context: The price he paid for two pizzas. Nasdaq puts the pizzas at about 41 dollars at the time.

beats.text: Someone else paid with their own money.
beats.note: Jeremy Sturdivant ordered the pizzas and received the 10,000 bitcoin in return.

beats.text: He said he could not keep doing it.
beats.note: Hanyecz wrote that he could not generate thousands of coins a day any more.

beats.text: The pizza was cheap. The offer was the story.

beats.line: Tech history is mostly small decisions.
